question: Can a first-time user interpret the recorded observations and their limitations while completing core tasks, and does the simplified navigation change accuracy, critical errors or effort?

conditions.label: simplified Overview/Explore/Research views with period brief and evidence drilldown
conditions.version_identifier: git commit and manifest run_id recorded at session time

held_constant: generated archive build and manifest run_id

assignment.randomisation: balanced blocks of 4 with a seed recorded before the first session

sample.stopping_rule: stop at 12 completed sessions or the prearranged cutoff date, whichever comes first
sample.power_statement: Underpowered pilot. Detects only very large differences; intended to surface reproducible defects and interpretation failure modes, not to estimate effect sizes.
exclusions: build or run_id does not match the recorded plan

covariates: self-reported prior familiarity with satellite fire data, GIS or remote sensing (0-3), collected before tasks

tasks.name: select region and period
tasks.correct: reaches the stated country and month; stated figures correspond to that selection
tasks.critical_error: reports figures from a different country or period

tasks.name: identify peak recorded activity
tasks.correct: names the highest recorded month for the active metric and names the metric
tasks.critical_error: states the peak as the month with the most fires

tasks.name: explain raw versus aggregated counts
tasks.correct: explains repeat pixels and passes counted once per cell per UTC day
tasks.critical_error: says the difference is false detections, errors or double-reported fires

tasks.name: distinguish no detections from absence of fire
tasks.correct: states no qualifying detections were recorded and coverage is unknown

tasks.name: identify forecast or scenario research status
tasks.correct: identifies the forecast as research-only or the MiroFish output as a synthetic discussion
tasks.critical_error: treats a forecast or synthetic narrative as a verified observation or operational warning

tasks.name: report the activity unit
tasks.correct: states the metric is grid cell-days, not distinct fires or burned area
tasks.critical_error: states the metric is a count of fires or an area burned

measures.precedence: safety outcome takes precedence over effort when they conflict

accessibility_checks: keyboard-only operation of tabs, selects, calendar tiles, brief disclosure and map evidence selection with visible focus
screen-reader labels announce period, unit and value
touch completion of T1-T3 at 390px width with no horizontal page scroll

analysis.reporting: descriptive statistics per condition with actual completed sample size and all exclusions; differences with uncertainty intervals described as pilot estimates
prohibited: reporting significance as confirmatory at this sample size
describing the simplified design as validated, proven or preferred
analysis.null_result_handling: a null result is the expected outcome at this sample size and must be published as such

privacy.stored: anonymous task outcomes, times, confidence, pass/fail accessibility notes
privacy.not_stored: names, employers, faces, voices, contact details, raw recordings
privacy.public_artifacts: no identifiable detail in the repository or any public issue

release_status: no usability result exists; none may be cited
